headword: {実体経済|じったいけいざい}

definitions.gloss: the real economy (production and trade of goods and services)
definitions.explanation: The part of the economy that produces and trades actual goods and services, as opposed to financial markets and asset prices.

examples.japanese: {実体経済|じったいけいざい}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧。
examples.english: The impact on the real economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{実体経済|じったいけいざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれている→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧。
examples.english: Share prices are out of step with the real economy.

examples.japanese: {金融危機|きんゆうきき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧{実体経済|じったいけいざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{波及|はきゅう}→波及：09042_hakyuu⟧し、⟦{失業者|しつぎょうしゃ}→失業者：22385_shitsugyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The financial crisis eventually spread to the real economy, and unemployment rose.
